author: bobyv87
text:
See, here is a big problem, i was thinking about that a lot. The
problem is, we have not so much choices when we need to use a retailer
broker for trading. What we could do instead is either take a look
always to T1 chart when we trade or use only m5 levels and higher to
trade from and in this way you could be sure that the ask line didn't
touched your m5 level, so you have a bit more space to work with back to
 BS. Or, why not try to rise quickly RTM fund, and pay for a good feed
from Bloomberg or Reuters. Or why not to be your own broker? But, until
then, we can still use mt4 and retailer brokers for trading but with
proper history data feed. And now, think about logic behind the market.
Why mt4 don't offer you tick charts? Maybe because retailers don't have
to know too much details about the real market price. And another fact.
If you have a proper data feed and you see that a level is fresh (on a
institutional platform), do you think that your retailer broker will
break that level so easy? Even if his ask line tested your level, they
can't break every level as they want. They still have to have
approximately the same feed like the institutional broker. So, if in
your insituttional broker data feed a level is holding price down i dont
 think the retailed broker will break that level by 100 pips. Sure, it
could happen, but most of the time not. I think with a proper data feed
you can be absolute certain that you have fresh orders inside a level or
 not and this can give you a massive edge. Until then i will try to use a
 broker which offer me the tightest spread in the universe. Anyway, its
interesting to do a study about how ask price affect a level.

EDIT: or why dont trying to sell at ask line, at least mental selling.
When we see that the ASK line hit our level we can try to enter early by
 0.1, 0.2 pips.

text:

don`t know. I fully exhausted. I`am already read 3 times If journal,

markepedia articles. But nothing works out for me.

I`am in forex already 8 years and i belive, that only this concept is
right and logical. I understand what is FL, FTR, QM, LS, RS, CP, PCP and
 other things, but I`am lost. Something I can`t to get, the last pazzle
and I don`t understand which one. In 10 trades that I do only 2 or 1 is
correct but with small move. I try to find why price move from here and
why is here, where is next target but I have only more cereal in the
head.

I don`t know what to do, how to see true demand or supply, but not 1
time per 10 attempts. Please, can somebody give me admonition. Which way
 should I go?

The answer to that is pretty simple!

What you're doing now, is trying to force the sand through the neck of the sand timer. This can't work.

So, get away from it long enough for it to settle itself in your mind.

Don't look at a chart of forum post for a week, a month, three months if necessary (everybody's different).

Trading with the ITs is not something which can be done by memory. It
can only be done by instinct: Unconscious competence. Trust your mind
to, without your intervention, organise what it's been taught, into
whichever format works best for your instincts.

So go. Indulge in your favourite hobbies, and think not of the market.

You've studied enough. You've given your mind a lot to process.

If you're meant to be a trader, it will process the information for you, without you.
